keyFindings.description: The match-budget test breaks out of the score-ordered loop, so the first candidate whose df would pass relatedMatchBudget (3,000) drops every lower-scored candidate after it, rare words included. A mid-df word the text repeats outranks df-1 words (tf x idf); reproduced with N=20,000, deploy df 1,800 x30, rollout df 1,500 x20, quokka df 1, xanthan df 2: picked only 'deploy'. When N/10 > 3,000 (N > 30,000) a single allowed word with df > 3,000 that scores first leaves zero terms, and the check answers 'searched ... and found nothing' without searching. Fix: skip the over-budget candidate (continue) and stop only at relatedTermLimit; add a test where a high-tf mid-df term outranks tf-1 rare terms (TestRelatedTermsStopAtTheMatchBudget uses tf 1 everywhere, so it cannot tell break from continue).

bounded is derived from r.Context(), so a client that disconnects (Ctrl-C, a browser leaving the page) during the check is answered and recorded as reason 'timeout' ('did not answer within 5s') at :389, :399, :476 and :522; recordRelatedChecks writes it through WithoutCancel. The records route counts reason timeout as skipped_for_time, the figure production acceptance P1 reads. Fix: record timeout only when the allowance's deadline fired (context.DeadlineExceeded with the parent still live) and give a parent cancellation its own reason in 0130's check constraint.

The issue source re-implements 0131's issue_embedding_spec as an inline lateral join; the comment says the coverage text is the trigger's byte for byte, but only a copy keeps it so. Call issue_embedding_text(i.title, issue_embedding_spec(i.key)) from issues i.
